svg.title: Settings Auto-Save Usual Portions & Search Reindex Visual Design Suite (Era 3)
svg.desc: Complete Era 3 visual design specification for Journey 2: /profile/settings showing Usual portions with no Save button (checked Use family size vs. unchecked auto-saving number input), Search index card strictly below Usual portions (Index missing recipes vs. Rebuild full search index), R3 contextual single-recipe Reindex in RecipeDetailSheet overflow menu, plus French 320px reflow and High Contrast AAA adaptation.
svg.text: WFS / Shared Table · Family Cookbook Era 3 · Journey 2: Settings Portions & Search Reindex
